source_text: Despexit Esau primogenita. Qui caelestia pro terrenis contemnit, imitatur Esau. Haec Homiliae X clausula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Despised Esau birthrights. Who heavenly for earthly despises, imitates Esau. These of-Homily X closing. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Esau despised his birthright >> Bible:Genesis 25:34]]. Whoever scorns heavenly things for earthly ones imitates Esau. This is Homily X’s close. Amen.
